text.autoconfig.hyf_20250817_test.title: Flight Enhancement Config
text.autoconfig.hyf_20250817_test.option: Controls the flying speed in creative mode. Higher values = faster flight. Recommended range: 0.05-1.0
Controls how quickly you stop when releasing movement keys. Lower values = stop faster, Higher values = more momentum
Master switch to enable/disable all flight-related modifications
Disable the natural generation of all caves. When enabled, no caves will generate in the world
Prevent ore generation near the surface, preventing holes from appearing on the ground
Y coordinate threshold. Ore above this value will not be generated. Default 58 = 5 blocks above sea level (63)
